_comment_min_duration: Drop utterances shorter than this (seconds). 0 = no filter
_comment_min_samples: Drop speakers with fewer utterances than this. 0 = no filter
_comment_feature_type: melspectrogram or mfcc. Must match at inference
_comment_n_fft: FFT window size in samples (512 = 32ms at 16kHz)
_comment_segment: Fixed audio segment length for training (seconds). Short audio is loop-repeated
_comment_emb: Speaker embedding dimension. Model output is L2-normalized to this size
_comment_spk_batch: Must be even (half male + half female). Batch size = speakers_per_batch x samples_per_speaker
_comment_sps: Utterances per speaker per batch. >=2 needed for prototypical loss
_comment_warmup: Linear LR warmup steps, then cosine decay to 0
_comment_amp: Mixed precision training. Only works on CUDA
_comment_seed: Random seed for reproducibility (random, numpy, torch, workers)
_comment_aam_weight: Weight of AAMSoftmax in combined loss
_comment_proto_weight: Weight of Prototypical in combined loss. aam_weight + proto_weight should > 0
_comment_aam_margin: Angular margin for AAMSoftmax (radians). Larger = harder separation
_comment_val_split: Fraction of speakers held out for validation (gender-balanced, no speaker leak)
_comment_log_interval: Print training stats and log to TensorBoard every N steps
_comment_keep_ckpt: Keep only last N step checkpoints. best_model.pt is never deleted
_comment_ema_alpha: EMA update rate for speaker bank. Higher = faster tracking, noisier. new = (1-alpha)*old + alpha*batch
_comment_ema_warmup: Start computing diagnostics after this many steps (bank needs time to populate)
_comment_diag_interval: Compute and log diagnostic scores every N steps (after warmup)
_comment_diag_score: EMA smoothing for diagnostic scores themselves (separate from bank alpha)
_comment_cold: Ignore speakers not seen in last N steps when computing mix diagnostics
_comment_mix_sample: Max speakers to sample for pairwise mix computation (controls cost)
_comment_lr_finder_flag: Run LR range test before training. Only on fresh start, not resume
_comment_lr_auto: Auto-apply suggested LR. false = just log suggestion
_comment_augmentation: --- AUGMENTATION (all disabled by default, set prob > 0 to enable) ---

augmentation._comment_noise: Probability of adding noise. Needs noise_file (path to noise wav list)
augmentation._comment_snr: Random SNR range in dB. Lower = more noise
augmentation._comment_reverb: Probability of adding reverberation. Needs reverb_file (path to RIR wav list)
augmentation._comment_speed: Randomly pick one factor. <1 = slower/longer, >1 = faster/shorter
augmentation._comment_specaug: SpecAugment: random frequency + time masking on spectrogram
